name: herdr-conductor
description: Conduct coding agents in herdr: discover, start, prompt, wait, answer dialogs, verify on the machine, review across harnesses, worktrees and saved machines.

interface.longDescription: Discover, start, prompt, wait on, read and answer coding agents (claude, codex, agy and others) in herdr workspaces, tabs, panes and worktrees, locally or on a saved machine. A guard hook denies the herdr never-list; the ledger keeps long runs honest.
